'''2005 U.S. National Championship Brandon Ruck DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Ruck]] at [[2005 U.S. National Championship]], finishing 2nd; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brandon "Jabba_the_Ruck" Ruck (2005-07-09).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34973 2nd Place Origins 2005 Vane (V) from Hell]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070921201604/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34973 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brandon Ruck]]
* '''Event:''' [[2005 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Finish:''' 2nd
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-30-Combat_Readiness-remaster.webp|label=Combat Readiness (V)}}

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34973 DeckTech post] (preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070921201604/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34973 Internet Archive])
